description.zh:
需要创建并绑定标签的堡垒机实例的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
堡垒机实例ID列表。

N的取值范围为1~20。
> 可通过调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取堡垒机实例ID。
description.en:
The IDs of the Bastionhost instances. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs.

N can be from 1 to 20.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the IDs of Bastionhost instances.

description.zh:
资源类型定义。

唯一取值为**INSTANCE** ，表示堡垒机实例。
description.en:
The type of the resource.

Set the value to `INSTANCE`. This value indicates a Bastionhost instance.
The tags to add to the instances. You can add up to 20 tags.

description.zh:
实例的标签键。
N的取值范围：1~20。 

> - 该参数不允许传入空字符串。最多支持传入128个字符。
> - 该参数不能以**aliyun**或**acs:**开头，不能包含**http://**或**https://**。
description.en:
The key of the tag.

> - The tag key cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length.
>
> - The tag key cannot start with **aliyun** or **acs:**. It cannot contain **http\://** or **https\://**.

description.zh:
实例的标签值。  
N的取值范围：1~20。
> - 该参数可设置为空字符串，最多支持传入128个字符。
> - 该参数不能以**aliyun**或**acs:**开头，不能包含**http://**或者**https://**。
description.en:
The value of the tag.

> - The tag value can be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length.
>
> - The tag value cannot start with **aliyun** or **acs:**. It cannot contain **http\://** or **https\://**.

title.zh: 为堡垒机实例统一创建并绑定标签

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000 --tag Value=operation_test Key=operation --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000' --Tag.1.Key operation --Tag.1.Value operation_test --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
